_comment: TEST FIXTURE — not real company content, never shipped, never seeded.
estimator/company_content.json is gitignored, so a fresh clone (and CI)
has no company content at all and four tests that assert on its seeded
values fail. conftest.py prefers the real file and falls back to this,
which makes those tests deterministic instead of dependent on whatever
happens to be on the machine.
The warranty wording below is NOT invented: it mirrors _WARRANTY_BY_TIER
in app.py, which is tracked and is the structured source the PDF and the
JSON-LD already use. The reviews and certifications ARE invented, and are
deliberately obvious about it so nobody mistakes them for real customers.
This unblocks the tests. It does NOT fix the underlying bug: app.py's
_seed_data_dir() lists company_content.json alongside five files that are
all tracked, so a rebuilt Railway volume still comes up with empty trust
blocks. Track the real file to close that. See CLAUDE.md.
